failures.question: 首单在 2017 年上半年的用户，在 2017 年下半年是否再次下单？按月留存率是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH 
-- 2017年上半年首单用户
first_half_2017_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_date
    FROM 
        orders o
    WHERE 
        o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND 
        o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-07-01'
    GROUP BY 
        o.customer_id
),
-- 这些用户在2017年下半年的订单
second_half_2017_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM 
        orders o
    WHERE 
        o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-07-01' AND 
        o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' AND 
        o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM first_half_2017_customers)
    GROUP BY 
        o.customer_id
),
-- 按月统计留存情况
monthly_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM fh.first_order_date) AS first_order_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fh.customer_id) AS first_half_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sh.order_count > 0 THEN fh.customer_id END) AS retained_customers
    FROM 
        first_half_2017_customers fh
    LEFT JOIN 
        second_half_2017_orders sh ON fh.customer_id = sh.customer_id
    GROUP BY 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM fh.first_order_date)
)
SELECT 
    first_order_month,
    first_half_customers,
    retained_customers,
    ROUND(retained_customers * 100.0 / first_half_customers, 2) AS retention_rate_percent
FROM 
    monthly_retention
ORDER BY 
    first_order_month
LIMIT 6;

failures.question: 2017 年和 2018 年各月 GMV 分别是多少？并计算 2018 年相对 2017 年同月的同比增长率。
failures.generatedSql:
WITH 
gmv_2017 AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
        SUM(si.gross_amount) AS gmv
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        settlement_items si ON o.order_id = si.order_id
    WHERE 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
    GROUP BY 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
gmv_2018 AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
        SUM(si.gross_amount) AS gmv
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        settlement_items si ON o.order_id = si.order_id
    WHERE 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
    GROUP BY 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(g2017.month, g2018.month) AS month,
    COALESCE(g2017.gmv, 0) AS gmv_2017,
    COALESCE(g2018.gmv, 0) AS gmv_2018,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(g2017.gmv, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((COALESCE(g2018.gmv, 0) - COALESCE(g2017.gmv, 0)) / COALESCE(g2017.gmv, 0)) * 100
    END AS growth_rate_percentage
FROM 
    gmv_2017 g2017
FULL OUTER JOIN 
    gmv_2018 g2018 ON g2017.month = g2018.month
ORDER BY 
    month
LIMIT 12;
